title: Baby Sitting in Wicker Chair, 1958 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot from 1958 showing a six-month-old baby boy named Ken sitting inside a large round wicker bowl chair. He is wearing a short-sleeved top, striped shorts, and white booties while looking straight into the camera lens. The back of the photo includes a purple stamp reading '069' and handwritten cursive notes marking his 6-month milestone on September 9, 1958.
